subject.title: fix(ui): restore Control UI E2E coverage

question: Should this maintainer-labelled Control UI regression repair merge after a maintainer confirms the session-key equivalence boundary and accepts the available proof level?
rationale: The protected label blocks automated cleanup, and enabling an abort action across equivalent persisted session keys is a user-visible session-control boundary that needs owner confirmation.
